decided.singular: These are the sharp spikes that rise well above the usual 5-25 band of the curve: the peak near 51 around day 152, the peak near 35 around day 274, the plateau near 35-40 around days 313-320, and the high start near 36 at day 1.
decided.recurrence: Local maxima repeat about every 26-27 days, near days 44, 71, 97, 123 and 151 and again near 247 and 273, with smaller bumps in between.
decided.quarter: Q2 has the highest peak of the year (about 51 near day 152) and a consistently raised baseline of 15-27 for days 95-165.

answer.guess: A daily geomagnetic activity index (for example ap/Kp, which comes in 8 three-hour values per day) with the 27-day solar rotation recurrence.
